visual_review: Native inspected against Standard, including side-by-side enlarged muzzle comparison: same two visible muzzle slots and sight, same shallow diagonal, twin barrel/lower tube lengths, walnut stock/fore-end, original brass bands, plates and pins, large oval lever loop and attached trigger. Cleaner even dark metal and clean oiled walnut, existing brass polished, one narrow uncoloured engraved contour along upper receiver side. Existing brass remains original material rather than a new grade colour. No new ornament, coloured inlay or repair. Honest measured outline drift remains review-required.
